# Governance Surfaces (the dissolved constitution — Shapes 1-5) — checklist

- [ ] Is the CLAUDE.md governance region present between the begin/end markers with no setup-owned content outside them; a Ratified stamp line (version · date · production floor + declared depth · modules); a one-line-per-principle index that closes index->home->ledger both ways; universal principles as short RFC 2119 lines with floor principles first and marked (NON-NEGOTIABLE); technology-stack lines with actual mandated choices (no placeholders); a quality-gates summary with actual commands; a governance-operations block (ledger pointer + amend route); and the preserved carve-outs (mochiko:output-style pair, mochiko:domain-registry block) still carrying their pre-run values?
- [ ] For every rules file that exists, do its `paths` globs cover every path whose code can violate the concern (per-layer violation test against the kept architecture card, not just the mechanism's home layer), is it one concern per file with RFC 2119 operative rules, and does it point to the ledger for metadata rather than restating it?
- [ ] Is the ledger complete per Shape 3 — a Governance Floor header (production floor + declared depth + modules or none + fact-profile trace), Waivers (each with standard/justification/revisit-or-permanent/trace, none naming a legal-mandate obligation), Amendment policy, Exception registry, Three-Part records keyed by GI-ID each carrying Enforcement + Testability + Rationale + a real Trace stamp, and an amendment log whose version matches the region stamp?
- [ ] Is the trace summary manifest present with one row per principle-bearing GI element (GI-ID · principle · source · primary home · companions present), plus the flagged-proposals and waivers lines?
- [ ] If an output-style rules file exists, is it a Shape-2 file scoped over the deliverable paths, marked edit-time reinforcement (not the carrier), preserved across regenerations with any user-added line surviving, and does it cite the shipped output-style rules rather than restating them?
